entries.name: template-application-stored-company
entries.claim: The application read finds a stored application only in the company it was created in, so a company A lookup of a company B parent answers nothing.
entries.original:
WHERE (c.tenant_id,c.environment_id,c.company_id,c.form_id,c.parent_id)=(t,e,company,form,parent)
    AND c.applied AND NOT c.probe;
entries.replacement:
WHERE (c.tenant_id,c.environment_id,c.form_id,c.parent_id)=(t,e,form,parent)
    AND c.applied AND NOT c.probe;
